INTRO.text: Welcome to the Comic Serial Generator demo. This app turns your ideas into an ongoing comic book series, one episode at a time. Let's walk through the full workflow.

HUB_OVERVIEW.text: This is the Cognotik App Hub, where all available apps are listed. Let's launch the Comic Serial Generator.

LOGIN_PROMPT.text: First, let's log in to access the platform.

LOGIN_SUCCESS.text: Logged in successfully. Now let's find our app.

APP_OPENED.text: Here's the Comic Serial Generator. It has tabs for your Idea, the generation Pipeline, the Series browser, Usage tracking, and Model settings.

CONFIGURE_MODELS.text: Before we start generating, let's configure the AI models. We need to select a smart model for creative writing, a fast model for parsing, and an image model for artwork.

MODELS_SAVED.text: Model settings are saved. Now we're ready to start creating our comic series.

IDEA_TAB.text: Let's start by entering a story idea. This will serve as the foundation for the entire comic series.

IDEA_TYPED.text: We've generated a unique randomized story concept using a Mad Libs-style template. Every demo run produces a different comic premise! Now let's save it.

IDEA_SAVED.text: The idea is saved. Now let's move to the Pipeline tab to start generating comics.

PIPELINE_TAB.text: The Pipeline tab shows the generation workflow. We can see the stages: Idea, Comic number one, sequels, and finally an HTML book compilation.

GENERATE_COMIC_1.text: Let's generate the first comic episode. This will establish the characters, setting, art style, and narrative arc based on our idea.

COMIC_1_DONE.text: The first comic episode has been generated! Let's take a look at it.

VIEW_COMIC_1.text: Here's our first episode, rendered from Markdown. The AI has created panels, dialogue, and scene descriptions based on our story concept.

GENERATE_SEQUEL.text: Now let's generate a sequel episode. Each new episode builds on the previous one while staying true to the original idea.

SEQUEL_DONE.text: Episode two is ready! The story continues with new developments while maintaining consistency with the first episode.

BATCH_INTRO.text: For faster series creation, we can use batch generation to produce multiple episodes in sequence automatically.

BATCH_STARTED.text: Batch generation is running. The pipeline will generate each episode one after another, with each building on the last.

BATCH_DONE.text: Batch generation is complete. We now have a full series of comic episodes.

HTMLBOOK_INTRO.text: Now let's compile all episodes into a single HTML comicbook for a polished reading experience.

HTMLBOOK_DONE.text: The HTML comicbook has been compiled. All episodes are combined into one beautiful, self-contained page.

SERIES_TAB.text: Let's check the Series tab to browse all our generated episodes in the accordion viewer.

SERIES_OVERVIEW.text: Here we can see all episodes listed as expandable cards. Each one can be opened to read the full comic content.

SETTINGS_TAB.text: Finally, let's look at the Model settings. Here you can choose which AI models to use for smart reasoning, fast processing, and image generation.

SETTINGS_OVERVIEW.text: The smart model handles creative writing, the fast model handles parsing, and the image model generates the comic panel artwork.

USAGE_TAB.text: The Usage tab lets you track token usage and estimated costs for all AI operations in this session.

OUTRO.text: And that's the complete workflow of the Comic Serial Generator! From a single idea to a full comic book series, all powered by AI. Thank you for watching!
